title: spec: the ADR-0087 entry page-record-no-component-refused still says the console draws a blank panel for a stored record page that places no component; since #32478 it draws an explanation panel
body:
domain:ui#6 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUAXJEaRNwDiLuAvEZ

Follow-up of #32478 (PR #32693): contract-review finding F2 (record 6824149693, should-fix, outside the claim's `ui/**` surface). Filed at landing as the review asked.

Filing category: ② stale published text (a consumer-facing migration entry states a behaviour that is no longer true). reach: read on `main` at landing; the console change is PR #32693.

## 维护者速读

升级指南里「记录页没放任何组件会被拒绝」这一条（ADR-0087 迁移条目）写着：已存成这样的页面在修好或删掉之前，控制台仍会画一个空白面板。#32478 合并后，控制台不再画空白，而是画一个说明面板：写明页面名，并给出三种修法（往区域里放组件、改成 `slotted`、删掉页面）。这句话需要改成现在的行为。只改文案，不改任何规则。

## What is stale

`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.page-record-no-component-refused.ts` (~:59–60), `consumerAction` / description:

> … until it is fixed or deleted, the console still draws the blank panel for its object.

After PR #32693, the Console's record view runs the spec's own `checkPageRecordPlacesComponent` on the assigned page. Where it refuses, the view draws an `Empty` panel (`data-testid="record-page-places-no-component"`) that names the page and gives the spec's three fixes (place components in a region, make the page `slotted`, or delete it). A `full` page that also carries off-spec `children` gets the same panel and no longer draws its children.

The `acceptanceCriteria` sentence (~:69, "… shows its detail view … not a blank panel") reads "not the explanation panel" after the change; check it in the same edit.

## Expected

The entry says what the Console draws today for such a stored row: an explanation panel naming the page and the three fixes, not a blank panel. Keep it prose only (no rule, schema or `id` change). Regenerate whatever the repo derives from migration entries (the upgrade guide under `content/docs/**`, if it renders this text), per `packages/spec` conventions.

Reader who acts: `domain:spec`. Triage decides the grade.

The entry was introduced by #32434's line of work and is pinned by `packages/spec/src/ui/page.test.ts` (~:1287).
